coupon_dx_m.label: authored
coupon_dx_m.basis: the play of a part a fitter places by hand under the toggle clamps (+-3 mm); world x, along the table and the joint

coupon_dy_m.label: authored
coupon_dy_m.basis: +-3 mm; world y, toward / away from the robots

coupon_yaw_deg.label: authored
coupon_yaw_deg.basis: +-2 deg about the vertical through the root's start

wire_stickout_m.label: derived
wire_stickout_m.basis: the wire a previous weld leaves: electrical stick-out = contact tip to work - 1/4 in (Lincoln L-56, read) over the robotic contact-tip-to-work 1/2-3/4 in (Bernard/Tregaskiss, Lincoln C4.200, read) = 1/4-1/2 in
wire_stickout_m.physical_effect: how far the wire stands out of the contact tip at tick 0 (run-in to the strike, touch sensing, the position-torch wire-on-root check)

draft_m_s.label: authored range under a read limit
draft_m_s.basis: AWS D1.1 s5.12.1: GMAW only where the wind at the weld is <= 5 mph (2.2 m/s) unless sheltered (read); 0-2.0 m/s keeps every entry under the limit
draft_m_s.physical_effect: air reaches the shield from 1.4 m/s (Kobelco's chart at the cell's 19 L/min, arc.air_fraction): at most 0.6 % air at 2 m/s, under the porosity onset alone, adding to a longer stand-off or a steeper torch; convection does not depend on air speed

variation_0: authored layout (= legacy seed 0), split train
config_seed: Config.seed = 100000 + variation_id (0 for variation 0): the entry's identity in the world's configuration (the tack weld is cached per physics hash, not per entry)

fixture_check.rule: both clamp pads on the plate with >= 2 mm to every edge (authored); plate on the table; a pose outside is redrawn (the box's corner with dy > 2.3 mm and yaw > 1.7 deg)
